description: This file defines the 'SugarFolder' class, which manages folder operations such as CRUD, subscriptions, hierarchy, and email retrieval within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for handling folder hierarchies, email associations, subscriptions, and folder tree building.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: A class encapsulating folder management functionalities, including creation, deletion, updating, retrieval, hierarchy management, email associations, and user subscriptions within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the SugarFolder object with optional parameters, setting up database connection, queries, and default configurations.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromAllFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from all folders by removing its relationships in folders_rel table.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from a specific folder based on folder ID.

methods.name: checkEmailExistForFolder
methods.description: Checks if an email exists within the current folder.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves a bean (email or other entity) from one folder to another.

methods.name: copyBean
methods.description: Creates a copy of a bean into a different folder.

methods.name: setFolder
methods.description: Creates a new group folder with the provided fields.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves folder subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: setSubscriptions
methods.description: Sets a user's folder subscriptions, including parent folder logic.

methods.name: insertFolderSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new subscription record for a folder and user.

methods.name: getParentIDRecursive
methods.description: Recursively retrieves parent folder IDs until root.

methods.name: clearSubscriptions
methods.description: Deletes all subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: clearSubscriptionsForFolder
methods.description: Deletes all subscriptions for a specific folder ID.

methods.name: generateArchiveFolderQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL query to retrieve emails for archive folder.

methods.name: generateSugarsDynamicFolderQuery
methods.description: Generates dynamic SQL queries based on folder type, such as archived, sent, inbound, etc.

methods.name: getListItemsForEmailXML
methods.description: Retrieves email list items formatted for XML display, including metadata.

methods.name: getDynamicFolderCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emails in a dynamic folder, optionally only unread.

methods.name: getCountItems
methods.description: Counts all items within a folder.

methods.name: getCountUnread
methods.description: Counts unread items within a folder.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean (such as an email) with the folder, creating a relationship.

methods.name: retrieveFoldersForProcessing
methods.description: Builds and returns relevant folders for processing, considering subscriptions and user access.

methods.name: getGroupFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares group folder data for user settings, indicating selection status.

methods.name: getFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares folder data for user settings, representing both user and group folders.

methods.name: removeDeletedFolders
methods.description: Removes folders marked as deleted or invalid from a list.

methods.name: getFoldersChildForSettings
methods.description: Recursively retrieves child folders for settings display.

methods.name: getCountNewItems
methods.description: Counts new (e.g., unread) items in a folder based on criteria.

methods.name: getUserFolders
methods.description: Builds the folder tree structure for a user, including subscriptions and folder states.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeRefresh
methods.description: Creates a meta representation of a folder node for refresh purposes.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeFolders
methods.description: Constructs a tree node for a folder, including children and properties.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Flags a folder as deleted, also deletes its children recursively.

methods.name: deleteChildrenCascade
methods.description: Recursively deletes child folders and related relationships.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the folder, inserting or updating in the database, including handling subscriptions.

methods.name: addSubscriptionsToGroupFolder
methods.description: Adds default subscriptions to a group folder.

methods.name: createSubscriptionForUser
methods.description: Creates a subscription record for a user to this folder.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates folder properties and hierarchy.

methods.name: findAllChildren
methods.description: Finds and lists all children of a folder recursively.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves folder data from the database by ID.

methods.name: getFirstDisplayFolders
methods.description: Gets the first folder marked for display.

methods.name: isToDisplay
methods.description: Determines if a folder should be displayed based on user preferences and subscriptions.

methods.name: shouldFolderDisplay
methods.description: Helper to decide if folder matches display criteria.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleInboundIds
methods.description: Returns inbound email account IDs accessible by the user.
